questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is f****ree from error, select ‘No Error’.** 

Although he (1)/ studied regularly (2)/his marks didn’t improving. (3)/No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'3' i.e. error lies in the third part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In the third part of the sentence,** the usage of **'improving'** is incorrect Instead, use **'improve'**

 
• **According to grammar,** whenever we use the helping verb do/does/did we always use the first form of the verb as the main verb.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• I** did** not** know** Jamie had a knife.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-*** Although he studied regularly, his marks didn't **improve**.*

questions.question: **In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select **the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select ‘No Error’.&
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'3' i.e. error lies in the third part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 3 of the sentence, **the usage of **'declines'** is incorrect Instead use **'declined'**

 
• **According to grammar,** Whenever the whole sentence is in the past tense then write every verb in the past simple tense.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He **offered** the boys some coffee instantly they **declined** politely.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is**- *Buddhism originated in Ancient India around the 6th and 4th centuries BC, from where it spread through most of Asia, and then it **declined** in India during the Middle Ages.*

questions.question: **A**** sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in**<span style="font-family:c

options.text: This essay has been written by my cousin.
This essay was written by my cousin.
This essay has been wrote by my cousin.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'This essay has been written by my cousin'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While changing the Active voice into the passive voice we need to follow the given steps-
 
 
• Firstly, recognize the verb of the sentence or the tense of the sentence because in the passive voice we don't change the tense.
 
• Secondly, recognize whether the sentence has an object.
 
• Thirdly, if the object is not written then see whether the sentence has an infinitive phrase if yes, then make the passive voice of an infinitive phrase.
 
 
 
• So in the given sentence, the object is 'this essay' and the verb is the present perfect tense so in the passive the tense will remain the same.
 
• So the correct answer is **'Option 1'**

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement**** ****is needed, select "no improvement".** 

We have lost the magic of living, and (is mired) in numbers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'are mired'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **According to the grammar,** whenever we have 'adjectives/nouns/verbs' connected with the coordinate conjunction 'and' then we have to follow the parallelism.
 
• I**n the given sentence,** 'have' is connected with the coordinate conjunction hence at the other side of the conjunction we need to use the plural form of the helping verb which is 'are'.
 
• Also, if we have two different things happening in the sentence and they are connected with the conjunction 'and' then, we have to use different verbs.
 
• **In the given sentence,** two things are happening which is 'we have lost the magic of living' and the other thing is 'is mired in the numbers' as they both are different hence we have used different verbs for the subject 'we'

**So the correct sentence is-** *We have lost the magic of living, and** are mired **in numbers. *

The correct answer is **'has fascinated'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to grammar, 'that' is a relative pronoun whenever we have a relative pronoun we use the verb according to the antecedent of the pronoun here in the given sentence the antecedent is 'journey' hence we need a singular verb for this.

**So the correct sentence is- ***There is something in a train journey that **has fascinated** a lot of people and I am one of them.*
